Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: POC - request for 30 day extension + additional credits — Deal Desk recommendation

Team — forwarding Aperture's ask and Logan's note. Summary / recommendation below: 

Summary:
- Customer: Aperture Health (APH-4621) — clinical summarization pilot.
- Current state: Trial started 2026-10-01, nearing PLG token cap due to heavy long-document summarization tests.
- Ask: +200k free tokens (one-off) and 30-day extension to pilot to complete validation. Procurement asks for vendor confirmation before signing simple addendum.

Usage snapshot (attached): ~165k tokens used this month, estimate 220–240k if run for 30 more days at current cadence.

Recommendation (Deal Desk): Approve a one-off credit of 150k tokens + 30-day extension on condition that Aperture: 1) signs the attached PO C scope addendum, 2) constrains peak batch sizes to agreed thresholds (see suggested guardrails in doc). Rationale: preserves runway for validation while limiting downside; this is consistent with previous one-off approvals for health prospects when procurement is engaged.

If approved, we'll issue credits as a consumption credit against the existing trial and set an automatic expiry after 30 days. If the execs prefer, we can alternatively grant the full 200k but require a short-term MSA addendum.

Please reply with APPROVE / APPROVE w/CONDITIONS / DECLINE. I'm happy to stand up a 15-min sync.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachment: aperture_poc_scope_addendum_v2.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC - request for 30 day extension + additional credits — Deal Desk recommendation

Thanks for the clear write-up, Marissa. I reviewed the usage file and the proposed guardrails. Approve but with a modification:

Decision:
- Approve a one-off credit of 150k tokens for Aperture Health (consumption credit applied to trial).
- Approve 30-day extension tied to execution of the attached scope addendum and a brief MSA addendum specifying the credit is non-recurring.
- Require product guardrails: limit batch concurrency to the thresholds in page 2 of Marissa's doc; engineering to enable a soft quota alert to the AE if consumption exceeds 80% of the granted credit.

Please communicate to the customer with the above terms and ask procurement to sign the addendum. If they push for full 200k without signing the addendum, we should decline and propose the 150k + MSA route.

Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Hi Emma / Rajiv — good news: exec approval is confirmed with a small set of conditions.

What we can do now:
- One-off credit: 150k tokens applied as a consumption credit to your pilot account.
- Extension: 30 days from the current trial expiry, contingent on Aperture signing the attached POC scope addendum and the short MSA addendum (we'll route both).
- Product guardrails: we'll enable soft quota alerts and limit batch concurrency per the addendum; Marissa will coordinate with your engineering contact to implement the thresholds.

Next steps for Aperture (please):
1) Procurement: sign the attached scope addendum and the MSA addendum (I can route DocuSign links).
2) Engineering: confirm you can abide by the batch concurrency thresholds in the addendum (reply to Marissa).

If both are complete we will release the 150k credit immediately. If you want us to revisit a larger token allocation later, we can after you complete validation and discuss commercial terms.
